  "pipeline": [
    "extract_sections",
    "summarize_section",
    "summarize_figures",
    "build_surrogate"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "paper_title",
    "abstract",
    "experimental setup",
    "figures",
    "research questions"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "section-wise summaries",
    "surrogates",
    "knowledge graph hints"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "heuristic guess: paper-surrogate / research-paper summarizer :: paper sections (abstract/figures/experiments) -> section-wise summarization prompts -> surrogates/summaries",
    "schema hints: ['abstract', 'brief', 'experimental setup', 'figures available', 'knowledge graph', 'research questions']",

    "Title: From Model-Based Screening to Data-Driven Surrogates: A Multi-Stage Workflow for Exploring Stochastic Agent-Based Models"
  ]
}
